name: io.github.Servosity/auvik-mcp
title: Auvik MCP
description: Every Auvik endpoint as a command, plus the cross-client answers the Auvik UI and API cannot give

environmentVariables.name: AUVIK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Auvik API key (Basic auth password). Auvik > Admin > Integrations > Auvik API.

environmentVariables.name: AUVIK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Auvik regional API host with no path suffix, e.g. https://auvikapi.us1.my.auvik.com

environmentVariables.name: AUVIK_TENANT
environmentVariables.description: Tenant ID the inventory reads and sync default to (the --tenant flag overrides it). Child tenants are included in the response. Leave blank to use your credential's own tenant.

environmentVariables.name: AUVIK_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: The Auvik user email whose API key you are using (Basic auth username).

environmentVariables.name: AUVIK_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Auvik requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.
